title: Jim's books documenting government-funded anomaly research (AAWSAP/BAASS era)

tellings.quote: Then the the follow on that Jim wrote, Future Visions and New Insights, I think they're called. But that that he documents fully the research done there all the anomalies many witnesses this is a government funded

plain: A set of books, by an author Tim Gallaudet calls only Jim, is said to fully document strange events studied at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah, during a government-funded research effort from about 2008. Gallaudet, a retired Navy rear admiral, recommends the follow-up book, which he thinks is called Future Visions and New Insights, and says it records the research, the anomalies and the many witnesses. To him it matters because "this is a government funded" study, not a private hobby.
